text:
incident-bot: Pager: KV cache OOM spikes observed in hosted-runtime-us-west-2. Error rate ↑, nodes hitting OOM within 30-90s of long-prompt sessions. Auto-scale triggered but failures on shard alloc. Alert: kvcache.heap.oom >= 5 across 3 pods.
open-oncall: On it. allocating oncall slot, pinging runtime and SRE. @eng-runtime-jack @sre-maria please advise.
sre-maria: seeing repeated OOMs tied to sessions with context > 1.2M tokens. continuous-batching queues ballooning. Likely prefix amplification + no prefetch cap for these sessions. stacktrace attached in logs.
eng-runtime-jack: thanks. quick triage — are these a few customer sessions or broad?
sre-maria: looks like ~7 heavy sessions across 4 customers. one customer (acct: acme-markets) has automated ingestion that generated massively concatenated prompts.
prod-olivia: customers impacted: degraded latency and 502s for generation endpoints. short-term mitigation priority.
support-lee: CS report from acme indicates automated job ran at 03:11 UTC, produced 600k token single request. they thought batching would chunk but repo concatenated.
eng-runtime-jack: immediate mitigations I suggest: 1) set kvcache.prefetch.max_sessions=100 (hard cap) 2) enable session-level max_context=256k for hosted tier temporarily 3) disable continuous-batching for affected shard pool to stop queue amplification.
open-oncall: can we do rolling patch now? need approval from infra.
infra-bot: rolling-restart plan created: rr-1812349999-1 targeting pool hosted-usw2-runtime. ETA 4m to first restart.
sre-maria: patch to disable continuous-batching on group rg-47 applied to canary pod. monitoring now.
eng-runtime-jack: canary logs show no new OOMs in 2m; queue depth flattened. patch looks promising. preparing a rollout to remaining pods with 30s stagger.
prod-olivia: alerting customers via status page on impact for generation endpoints. ETA for full mitigation 20-30m.
cs-ana: drafting message for acme customer, suggesting they backfill smaller requests and we'll waive rate surge charges.
support-lee: capturing customer logs to help them fix ingest process.
sre-maria: also enabling emergency eviction policy: kvcache.eviction.strategy=aggressive and lowering kvmap.max_keys_per_session to 50k as temporary limit.
eng-runtime-jack: applying config patch to all runtime pods now:
```
kubectl set env daemonset/runtime-pool CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false --namespace=hosted-usw2
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -p '{"data":{"kvcache.prefetch.max_sessions":"100","session.max_context_tokens":"256000","kvcache.eviction.strategy":"aggressive","kvmap.max_keys_per_session":"50000"}}'
```
open-oncall: rolling changes applied to 8/8 pods. monitoring.
sre-maria: OOM alarms have trended down to 0/last 10m. token throughput back to normal, latency improving.
eng-runtime-jack: follow-up tasks: 1) create prefetch circuit-breaker to auto-throttle sessions with unexpected context growth 2) add server-side soft limit that returns 4xx for >300k token requests with clear error + remediation link 3) run a canary suite to ensure no perf regression on small sessions.
prod-olivia: logging note: capture a sample of the offending requests and redact PII, attach to incident ticket.
cs-ana: customer outreach: acme acknowledged bug in ingestion, agreed to pause job while we stabilize.
support-lee: created support ticket INC-2026-1812, linking to monitoring graphs and next steps.
open-oncall: are there any remaining hotspots?
sre-maria: one pod showed transient high RSS during restart but recovered. no further OOMs.
infra-bot: deployment rr-1812349999-1 completed at 03:46 UTC.
eng-runtime-jack: labeling: root cause = runaway context from customer ingestion + missing prefetch/session caps, contributing = continuous-batching amplification.
prod-olivia: customer impact: ~4 customers saw degraded generation for ~22 minutes, no data loss, we mitigated within SLA window. recommend status update draft for status.redwood.com.
open-oncall: handing off to night SRE. please pick up follow-ups: create revert-safe changelist, add integration test for large-session rejection, and track billing correction for affected customers.
sre-maria: acknowledged. I'll own follow-ups and write postmortem template.
eng-runtime-jack: PR references: runtime#4621 (prefetch breaker), runtime#4622 (session soft-limit).
cs-ana: I'll follow on customer comms in morning.
open-oncall: closing incident thread here, leaving notes in #incidents. Thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: kvcache-hosted-runaway-context-1812349999 resolved by config roll and canary.
